questions.question:
다음 우리말을 영작 할 때 빈칸에 들어갈 알맞은 것은? (답 2개)
너는 방을 청소 해야만 한다.
= You _______ clean your room.
questions.explanation: 현재 상황에서 해야 할 의무를 나타낼 때는 'have to'를 사용합니다.

questions.question:
다음 밑줄 친 부분과 바뀔 수 있는 것은? 
You **don't have to** take this medicine.
questions.explanation: 'don't have to'는 '~할 필요가 없다'는 의미로 'need not'과 같은 의미입니다.

questions.question:
다음 두 문장의 의미가 같도록 빈칸에 들어갈 알맞은 것은?
Minji must wash the dishes.
= Minji _______ wash the dishes.
questions.explanation: 'must'는 3인칭 단수주어와 함께 사용될 때 'has to'로 바꾸어 쓸 수 있습니다.

questions.question:
다음 일을 친 부분과 바뀔 수 있는 것은? 
You **must** be on time.
questions.explanation: 'must be'는 '~해야만 한다'는 의무를 나타내며 'have to be'로 바꾸어 쓸 수 있습니다.

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 알맞은 것은? 
Kate's room is so dirty. Her mom will be angry. So she _______ clean the room soon.
questions.explanation: 미래의 필요성이나 의무를 나타내므로 'has to'를 사용합니다. 주어가 3인칭 단수 'she'이므로 'has to'가 맞습니다.

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 알맞은 것은? 
A: Tom, do we have a word test today?
B: Not today. It'll be next Friday.
A: Really? Then, I _______ study today.
questions.explanation: 시험이 다음 주 금요일이므로 오늘은 공부할 필요가 없다는 의미로 'don't have to'를 사용합니다.

questions.question:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말은? 
You _______ visit her again.
(너는 그녀를 다시 방문할 필요가 있다.)

options: get up early in the morning
questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 알맞은 의미 있는 것은? 
Minsu has to _______.
questions.explanation: 'has to'는 '~해야 한다'는 의무를 나타내므로 행동을 나타내는 동사구가 와야 합니다. 'study hard for the test'가 가장 자연스럽습니다.

questions.question:
다음 문장의 빈칸에 들어갈 수 있는 것은? 
You ________ be kind to others.
questions.explanation: '~해야 한다'는 의무를 나타낼 때는 'must' 또는 'have to', 'should', 'ought to' 등이 올 수 있습니다.

questions.question:
다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 맞는 기간 알맞은 것은? 
A: Do I have to go to the dentist, mom?
B: ____________________
questions.explanation: 'Do I have to ~?'라는 질문에 부정으로 답할 때는 'No, you don't have to.'를 사용합니다.

questions.question:
다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 알맞은 것은? 
A: Must I leave now?
B: No, you _______ leave now.
questions.explanation: 'Must I ~?'라는 질문에 부정으로 답할 때는 'No, you don't have to'를 사용합니다.

options: You must not go to the party.
You need not go to the party.
You should not go to the party.
You may not go to the party.
You can not go to the party.
questions.question:
다음 문장과 뜻이 같은 것을 고르시오? 
You don't have to go to the party.
questions.explanation: 'don't have to'는 '~할 필요가 없다'는 의미로 'need not'과 같은 의미입니다.

options: We have to pay. It's free.
I have to say it was my fault.
Sorry, but I have to leave now.
Policemen have to wear a uniform.
You don't have to do it if you don't want to.
questions.question: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분이 의미상 자연스럽지 못한 것은?
questions.explanation: 'have to pay'와 'It's free'는 모순입니다. 자유롭다면 돈을 낼 필요가 없으므로 의미상 맞지 않습니다.

options: She have to wake up early.
He don't need to come here.
Does she has to wait here?
Do you have to go to the library?
I have to finish my homework yesterday.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 올바른 문장은?
questions.explanation: 'Do you have to ~?'는 올바른 현재형 의문문입니다.

options: Tom must don't go home now.
Monica has to take care of her sister.
You must not be late for school.
I don't have to return this book.
Does she have to wear this dress?
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 이상한 문장은?
questions.explanation: 'must don't'는 문법적으로 잘못된 표현입니다. 'must not go' 또는 'don't have to go'로 사용해야 합니다.

options: I have to take a rest.
He has to help my mom.
You have to make a house.
They have to write a report.
She has to take some pictures.
questions.question:
다음 대화의 흐름상 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? 
Semi: The weather is very nice. Let's go for a walk.
Kevin: Sorry, but I have a headache. ___________________________
questions.explanation: 두통이 있다는 Kevin의 설명에 대한 적절한 응답으로 'I have to take a rest.'(나는 쉬어야 해.)가 맞습니다.

options: (A) must, (B) should not, (C) don't have to
(A) should not, (B) don't have to, (C) should not
(A) don't have to, (B) should not, (C) must
(A) don't have to, (B) must, (C) should not
(A) should not, (B) must, (C) don't have to
questions.question:
다음 문장의 흐름상 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 알맞은 말로 바르게 짝지어진 것은? 
• You (A)_______ answer my questions if you don't want to.
• You (B)_______ make a noise in the library.
• You (C)_______ finish your homework by tomorrow.
questions.explanation: (A) 질문에 답하지 않아도 된다: don't have to (B) 도서관에서 소음내면 안 된다: should not (C) 내일까지 숙제를 끝내야 한다: must

questions.question:
다음 빈칸 ①~⑤에 들어갈 맞춤 적절한 것은? 
• I can hear you. You ①_______ shout.
• Plants ②_______ have water in order to live.
• Jason can't join us tonight. He ③_______ work late.
• Last week Anne broke her arm and ④_______ go to the hospital.
• There's an elevator in this building, so we ⑤_______ climb the stairs.
questions.explanation: ① don't have to (소리칠 필요 없다) ② must (물이 필요하다) ③ has to (늦게까지 일해야 한다) ④ had to (병원에 가야 했다) ⑤ don't have to (계단을 오를 필요가 없다)

options:
① You don't have to leave early.
= You must not leave early.

② They must be careful at dark night.
= They have to be careful at dark night.

③ He doesn't have to go now.
= He doesn't need to go now.

④ You don't need to spend a lot of money on new clothes.
= You need not spend a lot of money on new clothes.

⑤ Finish your homework, or you can't watch TV.
= If you don't finish your homework, you can't watch TV.
questions.question: 다음 중 짝지어진 두 문장의 의미가 서로 다른 것은?
questions.explanation: ① 'don't have to leave early'는 '일찍 떠날 필요가 없다'는 의미이지만, 'must not leave early'는 '일찍 떠나면 안 된다'는 의미로 다릅니다.
